name: BOOSTXL-EDUMKII Educational BoosterPack plug-in module Mark II
sources: User guide SLAU599B (revised July 2021: Figure 1-1 photo, Tables 2-1 to 2-10 header pins, section 2.2 power, J5 note); CCStudio 21.0.1 AI board file ai/boards/BOOSTXL-EDUMKII/AGENTS.md (pin list from schematic SLAR105 rev 03); read 2026-10-07

columns.head: The parts
items: Crystalfontz TFT with an ST7735S controller, up to 20 frames a second, no touch
Two analog axes plus a push, and buttons S1 and S2
OPT3001 light (I2C address 0x44), 3-axis analog accelerometer, microphone
Color LED, buzzer, servo header J8, gator-clip touch input

columns.head: Header pins it uses
items: Screen clock, chip select, data; 17 is screen reset, 31 data/command, 39 backlight
Joystick X and Y, microphone, accelerometer X, Y, Z: six analog inputs
Servo, blue, green, red (or backlight), buzzer
Light sensor; its alert goes to pin 8

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: Jumper J5 picks what pin 39 drives: the red LED (1-2) or the screen backlight (2-3)
The TMP006 temperature sensor: discontinued in 2017 and no longer placed
Uses 26 header pins, so most LaunchPad kits lose a part or need a wire
